name: single-shot-software-build
description: Turn a one-line product idea into a complete, running full-stack system in a single orchestrated multi-agent build. The architect expands the brief with taste, freezes a compiler-enforced contract (types + config + design system), product-directs every screen and endpoint in prose, fans implementation out across parallel disjoint-ownership agents, then hardens through a compile loop, multi-lens review, adversarial verification, and a mechanical gate.
